title: Asking for Trouble
question: Why did the policeman ask the writer to come to the police station?

meanings.usage: 用于攀爬高处，如爬墙或修缮房屋
指花园中存放工具的小房子
形容用讽刺的语气说话，常带有贬义
指打断某人说话或正在做的事
表示对已做的事感到后悔
用于引出好的结果或运气好的情况
按门时发出的铃声，用来通知屋内的人
指说话时的态度或语气
表示非常接近但未完全达到
形容人正在忙着做某事
用于表达在两个选项中更喜欢哪一个
指出于某种原因大声说话
用于对问题或陈述作出回应

sentences.en: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
sentences.zh: 我回到家时，大约是凌晨两点钟。

sentences.en: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell,
sentences.zh: 我按门铃想叫醒我的妻子，

sentences.en: so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall,
sentences.zh: 于是我从花园的小屋里搬来一架梯子，把它靠在墙上，

sentences.en: and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 开始朝着卧室的窗户爬去。

sentences.en: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said.
sentences.zh: 我快爬到窗户时，下面传来一个挖苦人的声音：

sentences.en: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'
sentences.zh: “我认为窗户在夜间这个时候不需要擦洗。”

sentences.en: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
sentences.zh: 我向下看去，当看到一个警察时，我差点从梯子上掉下来。

sentences.en: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'
sentences.zh: 我马上后悔不该那样回答，但我还是说：“我喜欢在夜间擦洗窗户。”

sentences.en: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.
sentences.zh: “我也喜欢，”警察用同样的声调回答说。

sentences.en: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'
sentences.zh: 我不愿意打断一个正在忙碌的人，但你介意跟我到警察局去一趟吗？”

sentences.en: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.
Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我的喊叫声把妻子吵醒了，她打开窗户，而此时那个警察刚开始向我爬过来。

exercises.prompt: “when在并列句中表示'就在这时'，when前的分句用过去进行时，when后的分句用一般过去时” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
options: because of 与 because 的区别
情态动词need的用法（needn't have done）
exercises.explain: when引导的并列句 (when-Compound Sentence)：过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时：when在并列句中表示'就在这时'，when前的分句用过去进行时，when后的分句用一般过去时

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 用于描述故事发生的背景，或表示过去的某个时刻正在进行的动作

examples.en: I was climbing towards the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 我正在向卧室窗户攀爬。

examples.en: She was sleeping when I came home.
The policeman was standing below the ladder.

grammar.title: when引导的并列句 (when-Compound Sentence)
grammar.definition: when引导的并列句表示一个动作突然发生，常用过去时
grammar.structure: 过去进行时 + when + 一般过去时
grammar.usage: when在并列句中表示'就在这时'，when前的分句用过去进行时，when后的分句用一般过去时

examples.en: I was almost there when a voice said.
examples.zh: 我快要到的时候，一个声音响起。

examples.en: I was reading when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正在看书时电话响了。

examples.en: She was cooking when the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 她正在做饭时门铃响了。

grammar.title: would you mind + 动名词 (Polite Requests)
grammar.definition: 用于礼貌地提出请求，询问对方是否介意做某事
grammar.usage: 是一种非常礼貌的请求方式，回答时通常表示不介意或委婉拒绝

examples.en: Would you mind coming with me to the station?
examples.zh: 你介意跟我去一趟警察局吗？

examples.en: Would you mind opening the door?
Would you mind waiting here for a moment?
examples.zh: 你介意在这里等一会儿吗？
